race.description: Success Stud Equine Breeding Trotters Stand
race.comment: EZRA KAI (14) had been ticking along well before delivering with a deserved win in a 2300m race at this venue last start. Gives away 40m at the handicap but has the ability to take care of this field. CALL ME JACK (12) is another that found winning form last time out, digging deep to get home by a neck. That gave him a win and two placings from three tries at this circuit and distance. Big chance to make it two on the trot. CHIEF RUNNINGCLOUD (15) has placed in two of three starts since coming from this mark to win the last time he attempted a standing start race. That was over further but he could do it again. VALTINO (13) has been let down by manners in both outings since winning at this circuit and distance. Has been back to the trials since. Could bounce back.
